response.query: What numeric stability and lot-release acceptance criteria will we use (maximum Ct shift, allowable LOD fold-change, residual moisture limits), and what are the accelerated vs real-time study timelines and QC sampling plans?
response.answer: Numeric stability criteria include a maximum Ct shift of 0.5, allowable LOD fold-change of 2, and residual moisture limits of 0.5%. Accelerated study timelines are 18 months, real-time 36 months, with QC sampling plans every 6 months.
